title: Ownership labels registry
description: Format of registry/ownership.json (CF22, Sprut invariant 2; docs/images-and-ownership.md). Every container, volume and network Sprut creates carries the required labels; listing, stop and cleanup filter by them. Labels are a HINT, not proof: anyone with access to the engine can set them, so ownership is verified by inspecting the resource before every change (owned_when rules below) and the client only acts on resource ids it recorded when it created them. Keys in the label namespace are reserved: callers, task manifests and user configuration can never set them. Every label key and value, including caller-supplied extra labels, matches label_charset_pattern.

label_namespace.description: Reverse-DNS namespace of Sprut labels. A label key is in the namespace if it starts with label_namespace followed by `.`.

label_charset_pattern.description: Anchored pattern every label key and value must match (also caller-supplied labels outside the namespace).

labelled_resources.description: Engine resource types that carry the labels. Images are not labelled (they are identified by digest); WSL distributions are not labelled (ownership by registered BasePath, see rules).

required.description: Set on every labelled resource Sprut creates. A resource missing a required label is not Sprut's.

value_pattern.description: Anchored pattern of the value; a narrowing of label_charset_pattern.

value.description: Fixed value, when the label has one (owned_when = equals_value).

owned_when.description: Ownership check on inspect. equals_value: the value equals `value`. equals_current_profile: the value equals the id of the client profile doing the operation (a resource of another profile is not touched). not_checked: informational only (diagnostics), never part of the ownership decision.
